utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Good afternoon to everybody in the courtroom and those who are listening and watching the proceedings. First of all, our apologies for the delayed start. We had to discuss some procedural matters we have to discuss now. At the outset of today's hearing, the Chamber would like to note that no hearings were held last week due to the fact that the Chamber, together with representatives of the Prosecution and the Defence was on a site visit carried out pursuant to a confidential decision taken by this Chamber on the 2nd of July, 2010. Before the next witness is brought in, there were -- there are a few matters that should be disposed of with regard to the mode of testimony of this witness. The witness will be heard in closed session. Therefore, we move now into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are in open session, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Perhaps we can get information from the Prosecution, Mr. McCloskey, if there will be another witness available today or tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes. Good evening, Mr. President, everyone. We have a witness that will be available for tomorrow first thing. He's a bit older and was getting tired and we had a longer -- a three-hour estimate, so he's been sent home, but he should be ready to go, I'm told, first thing tomorrow afternoon.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. In that case, we have to adjourn for today, and we will resume tomorrow in the afternoon, 2.15 in this courtroom. We adjourn.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 19th day of October, 2010, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 5.54 p.m.,
